# QYL0120: No OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.* package next to AddQyl

## Description

AddQyl subscribes the HTTP server, HttpClient, Npgsql, Kafka and GenAI spans itself. A TracerProviderBuilder extension from an OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.* assembly records the same operations a second time.
